paragraphs: The traditional tech market bargain where every new gadget offered better performance and storage for a similar price is under pressure due to the global AI boom.

As tech companies rush to build massive data centers, they require huge quantities of specialized memory chips. Because chipmakers make much higher profits supplying data centers, consumer electronics manufacturers are facing a severe memory shortage and skyrocketing component costs. To cope, brands are raising prices, cutting down on device memory, or lowering specifications, which means consumers now pay more for devices with fewer features and slower speeds.

Building new semiconductor factories takes years and billions of dollars, and chipmakers are cautious about overinvesting due to historic market crashes. As a result, experts predict high prices and minor upgrades will continue for the next few years. Consumers are adapting by keeping their phones and laptops for much longer or turning to the fast-growing market for cheaper, refurbished devices.

paragraphs: Buying a new phone or laptop used to mean getting more memory and better speed for your money. Now, that is changing because of the huge demand for AI.

Companies building AI data centers need a lot of memory chips. Chipmakers prefer selling to these data centers because they make much more money. This leaves fewer chips for everyday gadgets like phones and laptops, and causes component prices to rise sharply. To keep prices from doubling, manufacturers are selling devices with less memory and lower specifications.

Because new phones cost more and offer fewer improvements, people are changing their habits. Many users are keeping their old devices for longer or buying cheaper phones instead of upgrading to the newest models. Experts say this situation will likely continue for the next few years.

paragraphs: New phones and computers now cost more money. But they do not give you much better features. This is happening because companies building AI computers need a lot of memory chips.
Chip makers prefer to sell to these big AI companies because they pay more. Because memory is hard to find, phone and laptop makers must raise prices or use less memory in their devices.
People are not happy to pay more for less. Instead of buying new phones every year, many people now keep their old phones longer or buy used phones to save money.
